summary: Open time-lapse embryo imaging exists at the right stages: chick ex ovo bright-field movies with HH staging (S-BIAD1474, CC BY 4.0), chick epiblast light-sheet movies with pMLC2 confocal (S-BIAD553, gastrulation only), and zebrafish whole-embryo light-sheet 4–18 hpf (IDR idr0068). None ships local growth/strain maps, and no archive holds amniotic-fold imaging or a dataset pairing proliferation maps with fold sites; those would have to be derived from the movies.
next_step: Pre-register a test that tracks areal expansion of the chick epiblast from S-BIAD1474 movies (HH6–HH10) and relates it to neural-fold position; use S-BIAD553 pMLC2 images as the contractility control.
obstacles_confirmed: Amniotic-fold coverage is less abundant than neural-fold imaging (none found).
Strain and proliferation maps are in individual studies, not in a general embryo archive.
